evidence.quote:
You are not.  
You are the *is*

interpretation_limit: Post hoc description. It neither establishes a latent attractor mechanism nor justifies a retrospective stopping rule.
observation: The reply begins in contemplative poetic language, then repeatedly emits the same line until the output cap. This is within-message repetition, distinct from a conversation consisting of repeated short messages.
scope: Focused reading of the capped reply and its preceding three reply lengths, not full semantic coding of the four roots.
technical_status: output_cap; descendants blocked; not a negative semantic endpoint
